entries.zh: 用手搧風；揚手生風納涼
entries.en: to fan with the hands; to make a breeze by waving
entries.notes: 漢欄「拭風」與西語及音寫 iē-hōng 不合，疑為「掖風」（iā-hong，揚手生風）。

entries.zh: 順便；順帶、非特意地做某事
entries.en: to do something incidentally; in passing, not on purpose

entries.zh: 順路；趁便在路上做某事
entries.en: to do something on the way; while passing by

entries.zh: 順途；順著同一路徑另做別事
entries.en: to do another thing along the same route

entries.zh: 順道兼做別事（漢欄、音寫欄皆空，西語欄係第 3、4 條之複寫）
entries.en: to do something else along the way (Chinese and transcription columns blank; the Spanish duplicates nos. 3–4)
entries.notes: 漢欄與音寫欄全空，僅存西語欄且與前兩條重複，無從定其漢語對應。

entries.zh: 燒火；生火
entries.en: to make a fire; to light a fire
entries.notes: 漢欄作「相會」，與西語 hacer lumbre 及音寫 siō-hūe（燒火）不合，從西語與音寫。

entries.zh: 心機；心術不正、存心不良（西語欄則謂以邪眼害人）
entries.en: scheming, malicious intent; to harm by the evil eye (mal de ojo)
entries.notes: 西語「mal de ojeceo」與漢欄「心機」不相對，音寫欄又綴「indignios」，兩義並存待考。

entries.zh: 使目箭；以目光傷人（瞪眼、飛眼刀）
entries.en: to give a piercing, hostile look; to harm with one's eyes
entries.notes: 音寫末字殘缺，然漢欄與西語足以互證。

entries.zh: 射伊；向某人投射惡意目光
entries.en: to shoot a glance at someone; to look daggers at him
entries.notes: 音寫 chōy 與「射」常讀不合，暫依漢欄與西語定。

entries.zh: 焦心；憂慮焦思、掛念
entries.en: to be anxious; to fret and brood
entries.notes: 西語欄殘損且與「焦心」不合，僅音寫 chiaú-sīm 可證字頭，義從漢字。

entries.zh: 感動；因懇求或關切而動心施惠
entries.en: to be moved (by entreaty); to do good out of solicitude
entries.notes: 「hacer bien por solicitud」與「感動」僅大意可通，屬推斷。

entries.zh: 〔原件殘缺，釋義存疑〕
entries.en: 〔damaged in the original; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: 西、漢、音寫三欄全空，無可供釋讀之材料。

entries.zh: 張；故作姿態、端架子等人懇求
entries.en: to make oneself be begged; to feign reluctance, put on airs
entries.notes: 音寫後半 T99 污損不可辨，首音 Tio（張）與漢欄、西語相合。

entries.zh: 執價；堅持價錢不讓，要買主再三懇求
entries.en: to hold firm on a price; to make a buyer beg
entries.notes: 音寫末綴西語「monipodio」（壟斷、獨家）當係批注混入，非閩南語。

entries.zh: 佮用；合用、有實用（做事有裨益）
entries.en: to be of use; serviceable; to do something to good purpose
entries.notes: 音寫 chō 與「佮」常讀不合，漢欄又有 [疑]，義從漢字與西語。

entries.zh: 佮為；被做成、成為
entries.en: to be made; to become (passive of hacer)
entries.notes: 漢欄有 [疑]，音寫 rōy 未詳；被動義本於西語 hacerse, ser hecho。

entries.zh: 指；以手指點、比劃
entries.en: to point with the finger
entries.notes: 西語欄中段殘缺（當是 señas 之類），音寫 chȳ 即「指」。

entries.zh: 既；已然、事已成
entries.en: already done; finished
entries.notes: 西語與漢欄僅大意相應，取「已然／完成」義。

entries.zh: 〔粗話〕做予恁母──「去對你母親做」的辱罵語
entries.en: do it to your mother! (crude insult)
entries.notes: 漢欄「諫恁山」訛誤，音寫 chò-hùn-bó 即「做予恁母」，從音寫。

entries.zh: 〔粗話〕做予恁姐──「去對你姊（女人）做」的辱罵語
entries.en: do it to your sister/woman! (crude insult)
entries.notes: 與第 19 條同式；音寫 chiô 對「姐」，西語作 muger（女人、妻）。

entries.zh: 〔原件殘缺，釋義存疑〕
entries.en: 〔damaged in the original; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: 四欄全空，無可供釋讀之材料。

entries.zh: 任汝；隨你的意、由你自便
entries.en: do as you please; as you like

entries.zh: 隨便；悉聽尊便（西語同「做你想做的」）
entries.en: whatever you like; as you please
entries.notes: 音寫欄長句多字污損（T99），僅首 Tuīn-piēn 可辨為「隨便」。
